<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <script src="/public/manager/vendor/xlsx.full.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
    <div id="output">{
  "READ ME": {
    "role": "OTHER",
    "headerRow": 2,
    "headers": [
      "Purpose",
      "Use this workbook to collect accurate information while the PWA is being built."
    ],
    "totalRows": 8,
    "validCount": 8,
    "emptyCount": 0,
    "warnings": []
  },
  "NEW BATCH": {
    "role": "NEW BATCH",
    "headerRow": 1,
    "headers": [
      "Supplier",
      "Date received",
      "Title",
      "Author",
      "ISBN",
      "Category",
      "Quantity received",
      "Quantity sold",
      "Quantity damaged",
      "Current quantity",
      "Total batch cost (DA)",
      "Unit purchase cost (DA)",
      "Selling price (DA)",
      "Notes",
      "Batch"
    ],
    "totalRows": 100,
    "validCount": 40,
    "emptyCount": 60,
    "warnings": []
  },
  "Sheet1": {
    "role": "ACCESSORIES",
    "headerRow": 1,
    "headers": [
      "PRODUCT",
      "CATEGORY",
      "QUANTITY",
      "unit purchase cost",
      "selling price",
      "supplier"
    ],
    "totalRows": 7,
    "validCount": 7,
    "emptyCount": 0,
    "warnings": [
      "Row 6: \"packagin paper vintage\" has no Quantity specified.",
      "Row 7: \"packagin paper christmas\" is missing Selling Price.",
      "Row 7: \"packagin paper christmas\" has no Quantity specified.",
      "Row 8: \"packaging paper swan\" has no Quantity specified."
    ]
  },
  "OLD STOCK": {
    "role": "OLD STOCK",
    "headerRow": 1,
    "headers": [
      "Title",
      "Author",
      "ISBN",
      "Category",
      "Quantity counted today",
      "Original purchase cost per copy (DA)",
      "Selling price (DA)",
      "Condition",
      "Notes"
    ],
    "totalRows": 100,
    "validCount": 47,
    "emptyCount": 53,
    "warnings": [
      "Row 27: \"┘â┘ä ╪┤┘è╪í ╪╣┘å ╪º┘ä╪¡╪¿\" is missing Purchase Cost.",
      "Row 27: \"┘â┘ä ╪┤┘è╪í ╪╣┘å ╪º┘ä╪¡╪¿\" is missing Selling Price."
    ]
  },
  "DEBTS": {
    "role": "DEBTS",
    "headerRow": 1,
    "headers": [
      "Creditor / person",
      "Type (supplier/family/friend/other)",
      "Original amount (DA)",
      "Amount repaid (DA)",
      "Remaining (DA)",
      "Date borrowed / incurred",
      "Due date",
      "Priority / agreement",
      "Evidence / notes"
    ],
    "totalRows": 50,
    "validCount": 1,
    "emptyCount": 49,
    "warnings": []
  },
  "OPENING POSITION": {
    "role": "OPENING POSITION",
    "headerRow": 1,
    "headers": [
      "Item",
      "Amount (DA)",
      "Status (confirmed / estimate / unknown)",
      "Notes"
    ],
    "totalRows": 7,
    "validCount": 7,
    "emptyCount": 0,
    "warnings": []
  }
}</div>
    <script>
    function safeCellString(val) {
      if (val === null || val === undefined) return '';
      return String(val).trim();
    }

    function safeCellNumber(val) {
      if (val === null || val === undefined || val === '') return null;
      const num = Number(val);
      return isNaN(num) ? null : num;
    }

    function getRowColumn(row, candidates) {
      if (!row || typeof row !== 'object') return null;
      const keys = Object.keys(row);
      for (const candidate of candidates) {
        const target = safeCellString(candidate).toLowerCase();
        for (const key of keys) {
          if (safeCellString(key).toLowerCase() === target) {
            if (row[key] !== null && row[key] !== undefined && row[key] !== '') return row[key];
          }
        }
        for (const key of keys) {
          if (safeCellString(key).toLowerCase().includes(target)) {
            if (row[key] !== null && row[key] !== undefined && row[key] !== '') return row[key];
          }
        }
      }
      return null;
    }

    function detectSheetRole(sheetName, headers) {
      const sLower = safeCellString(sheetName).toLowerCase();
      const hStr = headers.map(h => safeCellString(h).toLowerCase()).join(' ');

      if (sLower.includes('new batch') || (hStr.includes('supplier') && hStr.includes('date received') && hStr.includes('batch cost'))) {
        return 'NEW BATCH';
      }
      if (sLower.includes('old stock') || (hStr.includes('counted today') || hStr.includes('condition'))) {
        return 'OLD STOCK';
      }
      if (sLower.includes('accessor') || sLower.includes('bookmark') || sLower.includes('┘ü┘ê╪º╪╡┘ä') || sLower.includes('╪Ñ┘â╪│╪│┘ê╪º╪▒') || sLower.includes('sheet1') || (hStr.includes('product') && (hStr.includes('category') || hStr.includes('quantity')))) {
        return 'ACCESSORIES';
      }
      if (sLower.includes('debt') || hStr.includes('creditor')) {
        return 'DEBTS';
      }
      if (sLower.includes('opening') || hStr.includes('cash available') || hStr.includes('item')) {
        return 'OPENING POSITION';
      }
      return 'OTHER';
    }

    const b64 = "";
    const binStr = atob(b64);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(binStr.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < binStr.length; i++) bytes[i] = binStr.charCodeAt(i);
    const wb = XLSX.read(bytes, { type: 'array', cellDates: true });

    const parsedSheets = {};
    wb.SheetNames.forEach(sName => {
        const ws = wb.Sheets[sName];
        const raw2D = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(ws, { header: 1, defval: null });
        if (raw2D.length === 0) return;

        let headerRowIndex = 0;
        for (let r = 0; r < Math.min(raw2D.length, 15); r++) {
            const row = raw2D[r];
            if (Array.isArray(row)) {
                const nonNull = row.filter(c => c !== null && String(c).trim() !== '');
                if (nonNull.length >= 2) {
                    headerRowIndex = r;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        const headers = (raw2D[headerRowIndex] || []).map((h, i) => safeCellString(h) || ('Col_' + (i + 1)));
        const role = detectSheetRole(sName, headers);
        const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(ws, { range: headerRowIndex, defval: null });

        let validCount = 0;
        let emptyCount = 0;
        const warnings = [];

        rows.forEach((r, idx) => {
            const rowNum = headerRowIndex + 2 + idx;
            r.__rowNum = rowNum;

            if (role === 'NEW BATCH') {
                const title = safeCellString(getRowColumn(r, ['Title', '╪╣┘å┘ê╪º┘å', 'book_title', 'book']));
                if (!title) {
                    emptyCount++;
                } else {
                    validCount++;
                    const cost = safeCellNumber(getRowColumn(r, ['Unit purchase cost (DA)', 'cost']));
                    const price = safeCellNumber(getRowColumn(r, ['Selling price (DA)', 'price']));
                    if (cost === null) warnings.push(`Row ${rowNum}: "${title}" is missing Unit Purchase Cost.`);
                    if (price === null) warnings.push(`Row ${rowNum}: "${title}" is missing Selling Price.`);
                }
            } else if (role === 'OLD STOCK') {
                const title = safeCellString(getRowColumn(r, ['Title', '╪╣┘å┘ê╪º┘å', 'book_title', 'book']));
                if (!title) {
                    emptyCount++;
                } else {
                    validCount++;
                    const cost = safeCellNumber(getRowColumn(r, ['Original purchase cost per copy (DA)', 'cost']));
                    const price = safeCellNumber(getRowColumn(r, ['Selling price (DA)', 'price']));
                    if (cost === null) warnings.push(`Row ${rowNum}: "${title}" is missing Purchase Cost.`);
                    if (price === null) warnings.push(`Row ${rowNum}: "${title}" is missing Selling Price.`);
                }
            } else if (role === 'ACCESSORIES') {
                const prod = safeCellString(getRowColumn(r, ['Product Name', 'Title', 'Product', 'Item', 'PRODUCT']));
                if (!prod) {
                    emptyCount++;
                } else {
                    validCount++;
                    const cost = safeCellNumber(getRowColumn(r, ['Unit purchase cost (DA)', 'unit purchase cost', 'cost']));
                    const price = safeCellNumber(getRowColumn(r, ['Selling price (DA)', 'selling price', 'price']));
                    const qty = safeCellNumber(getRowColumn(r, ['Quantity purchased', 'QUANTITY', 'qty']));
                    if (cost === null) warnings.push(`Row ${rowNum}: "${prod}" is missing Unit Purchase Cost.`);
                    if (price === null) warnings.push(`Row ${rowNum}: "${prod}" is missing Selling Price.`);
                    if (qty === null) warnings.push(`Row ${rowNum}: "${prod}" has no Quantity specified.`);
                }
            } else if (role === 'DEBTS') {
                const creditor = safeCellString(getRowColumn(r, ['Creditor / person', 'creditor', '╪»╪º╪ª┘å']));
                const amt = safeCellNumber(getRowColumn(r, ['Original amount (DA)', 'amount'])) || 0;
                if (!creditor || amt <= 0) emptyCount++;
                else validCount++;
            } else if (role === 'OPENING POSITION') {
                const item = safeCellString(getRowColumn(r, ['Item', '╪¿┘å╪»']));
                if (!item) emptyCount++;
                else validCount++;
            } else {
                validCount = rows.length;
            }
        });

        parsedSheets[sName] = {
            role: role,
            headerRow: headerRowIndex + 1,
            headers: headers,
            totalRows: rows.length,
            validCount: validCount,
            emptyCount: emptyCount,
            warnings: warnings
        };
    });

    document.getElementById('output').textContent = JSON.stringify(parsedSheets, null, 2);
    </script>


</body></html>
